Best solar power kits for a tiny home

For a tiny home, I'd recommend a 2,000–4,000W solar panel system with a 5–10kWh battery as a starting point for off-grid living, depending on your appliances and electricity consumption.

There are three main options:

Shop

1. Portable solar power kit

Best for small tiny homes, weekend cabins, and backup power. Easy to install, with a battery and inverter integrated into one unit.

Shop

2. Complete off-grid solar kit

Best for full-time tiny home living. Includes solar panels, inverter, charge controller, and battery storage.

Shop

3. Roof-mounted solar system

Best for permanent tiny homes with suitable roof space. Can be grid-connected or paired with batteries for off-grid use.
